column1: # tests/gate-coverage-exempt.tsv — explicit skip-list for tests/test-*.sh files that must NOT run
# in the authoritative merge gate (tests/herd.bats + scripts/ci/run-suite.sh).
# Under HERD-295 dynamic discovery, tests/herd.bats globs tests/test-*.sh and runs each one; a file
# listed here is SKIPPED by discovery (and by the CI curated runner). The gate-coverage drift guard
# (scripts/herd/gate-coverage-lint.sh) honors this list and never reds an exempt file.
# Every row is a bare test filename (no path, no inline comment; whole-line match).
# Convention: add a row here ONLY when there is a known reason the test cannot run in the hermetic
# gate (e.g. flaky on CI, depends on live env). A NEW hermetic test needs no edit here OR in
# herd.bats — discovery picks it up automatically; only list it if it must be kept OUT.
# HERD-437 (2026-07-30): audited every row this file carried from the HERD-292 bulk population
# (179 rows, no per-row reason ever recorded). Each was actually EXECUTED under a sandboxed HOME +
# pre-seeded PROJECT_ROOT/WORKTREES_DIR (closing the HERD-436 real-ledger-leak class) to confirm a
# real pass before un-exempting it. 168 passed cleanly and are wired in (removed from this file —
# discovery now covers them). test-sandbox-concurrency.sh was ALSO removed: it turned out to
# already be wired via a bespoke @test block in tests/herd.bats (HERD-331, 2026-07-12) and this row
# had gone stale/redundant. The 10 rows below are the ones that did NOT cleanly pass — each has its
# own findings filed via `herd note` (journal) for a follow-up item; see the HERD-437 PR body for
# the full per-test evidence and the exact failing assertion. Do not remove one of these without
# re-running it and seeing a real, reproducible pass first.
# HERD-439 (2026-07-30): repaired 7 of those 10 and wired them in (rows removed). Each was diagnosed
# with evidence before any assertion was touched — two turned out to be REAL engine/test defects, not
# drift:
#   • test-cli-pane.sh            — genuinely UNBOUNDED hang, not the HERD-440 too-many-spawns shape:
#                                   check 5d drove `herd pane watch`'s HERD-322 background fallback,
#                                   which launched a REAL agent-watch.sh daemon that outlived the
#                                   `$(…)` capturing it. HERD_HERMETIC_GUARD (HERD-189) now stops the
#                                   launch and the run is ~13s. Also stopped orphaning a `sleep 9999`
#                                   per run — those orphans were the decoy the HERD-437 note read as
#                                   the cause.
#   • test-human-verify-policy.sh — the failing assertion was RIGHT: HERD-306 P5b deleted the bash
#                                   action pass and the Python port never re-emitted the two
#                                   `human_verify_policy` journal surfaces, leaving a consumer-only
#                                   event. Restored in the engine core, pinned behaviorally in
#                                   tests/test_live_runtime.py.
#   • test-pr-match-truth.sh      — stale STRUCTURE, correct behavior: HERD-323 (094168e) hoisted the
#                                   tick body into _tick_render_reconcile above the lib return, so the
#                                   fetch call moved. Proven by a swap-only bisect of agent-watch.sh.
#   • test-config-manifest.sh     — false DEAD key: the scan was bash-only and could not see the
#                                   Python core, where DOC_APPLY_PATH_GLOB is genuinely read.
#   • test-codemap-reconcile.sh   — the test itself was pipe-unsafe (`git log | grep -q` under
#                                   pipefail, HERD-299 class), failing deterministically on a match
#                                   in the first line.
#   • test-review-verdict-integrity.sh — RETRY behavior confirmed intact; only the console wording it
#                                   grepped for died with the bash action pass.
#   • test-seam-conformance.sh    — config-viability.sh migrated off a raw ANSI escape onto the theme
#                                   palette (the grandfather list is shrink-only, so no new row); that
#                                   unblocked B4, which then caught retirement.sh journaling without
#                                   declaring where journal_append comes from.
# The 3 rows below are the HERD-437 INCONCLUSIVE set, deliberately left exempt. They fail on the
# maintainer's box ONLY because a live herdr socket is present and context-guard.sh's real-pane-
# mutation refusal (HERD-310) correctly fires — a property of the machine, not of the tests. They must
# be re-verified on a host with NO herdr socket (or in CI) and wired in only if they pass there.
test-dead-builder-respawn.sh
test-review-pane-v2.sh
test-scoped-builder-verification.sh
